buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Due to limitations of GeM portal, the contents of bid document mentioned at Clause 5.1 have been upload ed at different sections of GeM portal as under: S. No. GeM Section Contents of Bid document 1. Scope of Work Volume-II: Technical Specifications 2. Payment Terms Volume-I: Conditions of Contract Section IV General Conditions of Contract (GCC) Section V Special Conditions of Contract (SCC ) 3. Pre-Qualification Criteria Annexure-A (BDS)

4. Instructions To Bidder Volume-I: Conditions of Contract Section I Invitation for Bids (IFB) Section II Instructions to Bidders (ITB) Section III Bid Data Sheet (BDS) along with An nexures 5. Additional Document 1 Volume-III: Bid Form & Attachments 6. Financial Bid Supporting Document Volume-III: Price Schedules indicating Price Break-up Qualifying Requirements General a) Qualification of bidder will be based on meeting the minimum pass/fail criteria specified below re garding the Bidder’s technical experience and financial position as demonstrated by the Bidder’s responses in the document submitted during bidding. b) Grid-India, reserves the right to waive minor deviations to QR, provided it does not impact the e xecution of contract. The decision of Grid-India in this regard shall be final & binding on bidders. c) The bidders who passed the Qualifying requirement given under this Annexure-A to Section-II s hall be further evaluated/assessed for the LCBS Criteria as given under Annexure-A, Part-B to Se ction-II. d) In case, bidder/OEM is a holding company, the technical and financial experience referred herein above shall be that of holding company only (i.e. excluding its subsidiary/group companies). In c ase bidder/OEM is a subsidiary of a holding company, the experiences shall be of that subsidiary company only (i.e., excluding its holding company). e) GRID-INDIA may assess the capacity and capability of the bidder, to successfully execute the sc ope of work covered under the package within the stipulated completion period. The assessment shall inter-alia include (i) document verification. (ii) bidders' work / manufacturing facilities visit; (iii) manufacturing capacity, details of work executed, works in hand, anticipated future & balanc e capacity available for the present scope of work (iv) details of facilities, manpower and financia l resources; (v) details of quality systems in place; (vi) past experience and performance; (viii) cu stomer feedback ; (ix) Banker’s feedback, etc. Part A: Technical Experience 1. The bidder shall have experience of similar work/item in any Government / PSUs/Banks/ any Public Listed C ompany during the last five years from the original date of bid submission, as per the following: a) One order executed for the similar item where executed value is not less than the amoun t equal to ₹ 11.95 Cr including tax [or ₹9.56 Cr including tax for MSE companies] OR b) Two orders each executed for the similar item where executed value is not less than the amount equal to ₹ 8.96 Cr including tax. [or ₹7.17 Cr including tax for MSE companies] OR c) Three orders each executed for the similar item where executed value is not less than t he amount equal to ₹ 5.97 Cr including tax. [or ₹4.78 Cr including tax for MSE companies

] Note 1: “Similar Item/Work” shall mean Any works/projects which include design, development, configuration, deployment, imp lementation and/or post-implementation support & management/maintenance of ei ther of the following: i. Enterprise Software Applications; OR ii. Web-based Operational Systems, shall be considered as similar works. Further, the above-mentioned work experience “Web-based Operational Systems” shall compr ise any three or more of the following five (05) components: i. Enterprise Application / Operations Management Systems ii. Application Database and Data Management Systems iii. Reporting, Dashboard and Management Information Systems (MIS) iv. Application Integration and APIs v. Application Infrastructure Deployment To arrive at the executed value towards meeting the same or similar work crite rion, the Cumulative value pertaining to above stated component will only be in cluded. Any items other than above indicated components i.e. software non-rel ated to above components or hardware would be excluded. However, in case maintenance of at least one year pertaining to above component is completed, then shall be considered. In the similar submitted work experience by bidder work order/ Contra ct/ LOA shall comprises of “Design, development, configuration, deplo yment, implementation” that may or may not include executed post-i mplementation support and management/maintenance. Bidder is required to furnish Purchase Order (PO) copies including Scop e of Work, BoQ and corresponding Completion certificate(s) from the cl ient for the work inter alia indicating final executed amount and date o f completion or any other document, authenticated by the client, contai ning relevant information to conclusively establish that the bidder has completed the requisite work(s) as per the requirement specified abov e. 2. Bidder shall have at-least one experience of configuration, deployment and maintenance of enterprise app lications on Hyper-Converged Infrastructure (HCI) or Virtualized Infrastructure environment (with minimum 3 nodes) in last eight (8) years from the original date of bid submission and project shall be successfully o perational for at-least one years from date of original Bid submission. Bidder shall submit copy of work-order alongwith successful corresponding completion certific ate issued by the respective client or any other document, authenticated by the client, contai ning relevant information to conclusively establish that Bidder has completed the above wor k and successfully operational for at-least one years from date of original Bid submission . 3. Bidder shall be an Authorized Business Partner/System Integrator of OEMs ((i) Operating System and (ii) D atabase platform) involved in the proposed solution/system. The bidder shall submit OEM authorization cer tificate and a back‐end support undertaking from OEM along with the bid for proposed solution support and services with the Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) for the entire duration of contract and extensio ns, if any. 4. Certifications: The bidder should have Valid ISO 27001:2022 and CMMi Level-3 at the time of original deadline for submission of bid. Bidder shall ensure the validity of the certificate for entirety of contract period a nd bidder shall also submit an undertaking to this effect.

5. Pre- Qualification Criteria for OEMs OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The undertaking to this effect should be submitted. Part B: Financial Criteria a) MAAT Requirement: The Minimum Average Annual Turnover (MAAT) of the bidder for the b est three financial years out of the last five financial years shall be at least INR 9.44 Cror es. Relaxation in Annual Turnover by 20% (i.e. ₹ 7.55 Crores) shall be considered for MSE & Start-Up bidders as per GoI guidelines, provided they submit the MSE registration/Start-up certificate. Further, the bidder must be mandatorily registered as an MSME/Start-Up bidder on the Ge M portal at the time of bid submission. The MSME/Start-Up status shall be verified strictly b ased on the bidder profile and declaration available on the GeM portal. In case the bidder h as not indicated or registered their status as MSME/Start-Up on the GeM portal at the time of bid submission, the relaxation shall not be considered, even if the bidder submits MSME/ Start-Up certificate separately with the bid. No post-bid claim in this regard shall be entert ained. [In case the date of constitution/incorporation of the bidder is less than 3-year old, the aver age turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria.] b) Net Worth: The Bidder should have positive net worth during each of the last three financi al years. [In case the date of constitution/incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the Net worth in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be tak en into account for this criteria.] c) Liquid Asset Requirement: The Liquid asset requirement of the firm would be ₹1.57 Crores , as on the date of original deadline for submission of bids. Part- C : General Requirements (a) Following documents shall be submitted by the bidder: i) Copy of PAN Card/ GST Registration. ii) Copy of Partnership Deed/ Company MoA & AoA or Certificate of Incorporation, as applicable. iii) Undertaking on the letter-head of the company pertaining to ‘No dues’ towards any Governme nt Company/PSU/ Govt. Undertaking towards. iv) Undertaking on the letter-head of the company stating that company is not debarred or blackli sted from any Government Company/PSU/Govt. Undertaking. (b) Cut-off date for all the requirements/Criteria shall be considered as original deadline for submissio n of bid. .
